reference_sql:
WITH base AS (
  -- one row per month from February to December 2024 and account with MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, m.account_id
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-11-01'
), churned AS (
  -- one row per account and month with a churn event
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT b.month_start, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c.account_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_pct
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.account_id = b.account_id AND c.month_start = b.month_start
GROUP BY b.month_start
alternatives:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per month from February to December 2024: the accounts with MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-11-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
), churns AS (
  -- one row per month with a churn event
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS churned_accounts
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT s.month_start, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(c.churned_accounts, 0) / s.accounts_at_start, 2) AS churn_pct
FROM starts s
LEFT JOIN churns c ON c.month_start = s.month_start

SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = m.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND e.event_date < m.month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_pct
FROM mrr_monthly m
WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-11-01'
GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-02-01', DATE '2024-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(m)
), base AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM months m JOIN mrr_monthly r ON r.month = CAST(m.month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY m.month_start
), ch AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS c
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month_start, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(c.c, 0) / b.n, 2) AS churn_pct
FROM months m JOIN base b ON b.month_start = m.month_start LEFT JOIN ch c ON c.month_start = m.month_start
